note: Both sets cover essentially the same facts and share the same errors: a 0.18 Hz tower natural frequency that contradicts the stated 0.170 Hz, the 0.170 Hz first-mode claim stated twice, the ocean-wave range stated twice, and legend labels used as quotes. Set A additionally fabricates quote text ('[vertical line at ~0.17]') that does not appear on the page, while Set B attributes the 0.17 Hz reading to Figure 4-1 and adds the WISDEM/OpenFAST design condition to the material claim. Set B is therefore marginally more faithful, though the two are close.
remarks: Both sets repeat the same facts under two names (tower-monopile first mode 0.170 Hz vs 'Tower, 1st Nat. Freq.' 0.17 Hz; ocean wave range twice) and both assert a 0.18 Hz tower natural frequency that the text contradicts (0.170 Hz). The 1P (0.09-0.13 Hz) and 3P (0.25-0.38 Hz) ranges and the JONSWAP peak (~0.11 Hz) are figure readings not stated in the text; they look plausible but are approximate. Both sets miss the 7% outfitting mass allowance, the 100 t transition piece mass, and the note that a floating substructure requires a stiffer tower. The table's Poisson's ratio row lists units 'Pa', a source-document error neither set propagated.
